summary: Validated end-to-end gating of must_change_password + POST /api/auth/change-initial-password on backend (via public URL) and the full frontend flow (/login → /cambiar-password-inicial → /admin). Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed. Frontend: E2E happy path passed (redirect, form fill, submit, success toast, redirect to admin). No password leaks in logs or responses.

ui_bugs.issue: Calls nav('/login') and nav('/admin' or '/dashboard') SYNCHRONOUSLY inside the render body (lines 26-34) when user is null or !must_change_password. This triggers the React warning 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' in the console. Wrap those redirect side-effects in a useEffect (or use <Navigate replace/>) to avoid setState-in-render.

action_items: Wrap the redirect logic inside InitialPasswordChange.jsx in a useEffect (or return <Navigate to=... replace />) to eliminate the 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' React warning. Functionality currently works but the warning pollutes the console and can hide real issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::get_current_user gate correctly returns 403 with dict detail {code: password_change_required, message: ...} — matches spec.
change_initial_password: response only returns {ok, changed_at}, never the password or hash — verified via test_10.
logger.info('password.initial_changed user_id=%s', ...) — logs only user_id, no password ever appears in backend logs — verified with grep on /var/log/supervisor/backend.*.log.
admin_bootstrap.py never logs password; result dict contains only status/email/user_id — validated by existing pytest suite (14/14) + new suite (15/15).
InitialPasswordChange.jsx: calling navigate() during render is a React anti-pattern that produces the warning captured in tests. Should be moved to useEffect.

Reuse this file — it self-cleans its test users. The only pending item is a MEDIUM-priority React anti-pattern warning in InitialPasswordChange.jsx (nav() in render body).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. The frontend console warning ('Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' — BrowserRouter/InitialPasswordChange) is caused by calling react-router's nav() during render. Fix: replace `if (!user) { nav('/login', {replace:true}); return null; }` with `if (!user) return <Navigate to='/login' replace />;` (already imported/used elsewhere in App.js). Same for the must_change_password=false branch.
